title: Uttarakhand Ranks 1st in New Criminal Law Implementation (ICJS 2.0)

items: **National ICJS 2.0 Ranking:** Uttarakhand achieved **Rank 1 with a score of 93.46** on the NCRB/CCTNS national dashboard for operationalizing the new Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), BNSS, and BSA criminal laws.
**Top 5 State Performers:** Uttarakhand was followed by **Haryana (Rank 2), Assam (Rank 3), Sikkim (Rank 4), and Madhya Pradesh (Rank 5)**.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Uttarakhand ranked 1st in ICJS 2.0 criminal law compliance; top 3 states: Uttarakhand, Haryana, Assam.
